templates.label: Barley, barley, wheat, beans
templates.rationale: Beans act as a break crop before the cereals and fix nitrogen.

templates.label: Five-year winter rotation with two break crops
templates.rationale: Wheat grown after a break crop avoids the take-all build-up seen in continuous wheat.

templates.label: Barley, barley, beans, oats
templates.rationale: Beans and oats break the cereal disease cycle while keeping spring work.

templates.label: Wheat, oats, beans
templates.rationale: Oats and beans are both take-all breaks for wheat.

templates.label: Three years of grass-clover, then two cereals
templates.rationale: A grass-clover ley keeps the soil covered all year and feeds livestock; cereals follow it.

templates.label: Maize silage, wheat, barley, beans
templates.rationale: Maize gives winter feed; beans break the cereal disease cycle.
